issueSnapshots.title: Keep mock credits, reservations and entitlements coherent and exactly once
issueSnapshots.workflow_status: verified — The bounded mock-backed increment and all in-scope acceptance criteria passed. Delegated Orchestrator acceptance is recorded; scoped commit, push to origin/main, and remote verification remain pending. This issue remains open until delivery is confirmed.
issueSnapshots.acceptance_criteria:
- [x] AC-01: Eligible grant, verified purchase fulfillment, capacity upgrade and each reservation/settlement/return are applied once under duplicate/reload/lost-response scenarios; ineligible returning identities receive no repeated grant.
- [x] AC-02: Concurrent quotes/processing/purchases observe coherent available/reserved/purchased-remainder/history/capacity revisions and cannot overspend through stale UI.
- [x] AC-03: Selected-duration ceil boundaries are correct; system preparation failure releases rather than charges, and synthetic cancellation outcome follows only its current explicitly confirmed quote.
- [x] AC-04: Pending purchase is never posted as success, reservations never masquerade as final charges and deleting a project/account never fabricates a refund.
issueSnapshots.completion_record:
Verified and accepted on 2026-10-24 under the owner's full-cycle authorization and the Orchestrator's recorded delegated acceptance in `_docs/evidence/frontend-implementation-2026-10-23/foundation-cohort-acceptance.md` (SHA-256 `B65985BC005E4229055B6A2705574D523324763EAF82A9862126DD417EE33E9A`). The acceptance covers the synthetic mock ledger, reservations, and entitlements increment in this issue.

- AC-01: service tests cover once-only welcome/purchase/entitlement/reservation effects and prevent repeated grants for returning identities.
- AC-02: concurrent stale quotes do not overspend; tests cover coherent available/reserved/history facts, capacity, and selected-duration boundaries.
- AC-03: cancellation stays bound to the confirmed quote; system preparation failure releases reservations.
- AC-04: pending purchases are not fulfilled, reservations are not final charges, and deletion does not fabricate refunds.
